data.body: **P2 — Preserve ERROR for statusless virtual failures.** Virtual child contexts report `status == null` and pass the thrown exception through `info.error()`. When that exception is a `DurableOperationException` with an empty error container and no diagnostics, this method now leaves the span `UNSET`, whereas the base reports `ERROR`. Contexts have no attempt span, so catching the failure and returning successfully can remove its only error-status signal. Treat a non-null `info.error()` as sufficient to set `ERROR`; use the details predicate only to decide whether to record an exception event. Update the empty-error cases in `VirtualOperationErrorStatusTest` to expect `ERROR` with no event.
